item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] Senate passes stopgap funding bill to prevent shutdown ahead of midterms
item.description: The Senate voted early Saturday morning to fund the federal government until Dec. 11 with the aim of averting another government shutdown before the midterm election, sending the bill to the House before leaving for a five-week recess. The continuing resolution (CR) passed 90-6 after Republicans spent days haggling over a provision inserted by the White House [...]
